def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A horizontal separator divides two patterns; combine their sparse
    # non-background marks cellwise, retaining the upper pattern's colors.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    if sep_rows:
        # Vertical divider case: each side encodes marks on a 3-column canvas.
        sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
        if sep_cols:
            c = sep_cols[0]
            left, right = [row[:c] for row in grid], [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            outw = max(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
            left_bg = max(set(v for row in left for v in row),
                          key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in left for v in row)) if left[0] else None
            right_bg = max(set(v for row in right for v in row),
                           key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in right for v in row)) if right[0] else None
            return [[0 if (j < len(left[r]) and left[r][j] != left_bg) or
                          (j < len(right[r]) and right[r][j] != right_bg) else 3
                     for j in range(outw)] for r in range(h)]

    # Stacked-pattern case: first six rows are the output-sized pattern.
    n = h // 2
    upper, lower = grid[:n], grid[n:]
    bg = max(set(v for row in upper for v in row),
             key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in upper for v in row))
    return [[3 if upper[r][c] != bg or lower[r][c] != bg else bg
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
